crossRefs.keyword: decreased continually. Heb. were in going and decreasing.the tenth

translations.web: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.
translations.bsb: And the waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.
translations.kjv: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
translations.asv: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
